job.job_description:
Job Summary

Build agents that read, reason, and act inside real enterprise workflows - and keep them working in production.


Responsibilities

Design and ship AI systems that do real work, not demos
Turn models into APIs other systems can rely on
Own quality and accuracy of the data feeding them
Keep models healthy in production - drift, evals, regressions
Work with Data Engineers on the pipelines underneath


Requirements

Production AI/ML systems you have personally kept alive
Deep Python, and real fluency in the current agent tooling
Judgment about when a model is the wrong answer
An instinct for the human on the other side of the output


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
